events.text: While investigating rumors of an immensely powerful undead dragon deep beneath the city of Peleveria, in Peleveran, Tuelhalva Drakewings discovered an even more sinister power, a somatic connection to the baatezu Gargauth.

src.title: History of the Cult of the Dragon

events.text: In the Year of the Awakening, 1001 DR, Aurgloroasa began to whisper dark promises in the ear of the High Old One, the high priest of Dumathoin, Dagan, son of Belgin, Blood of Jangarak, goading his ambition and desires.
The Mourktar Cell of the Cult was formed. Most of its members had ties to the church of Bane and the Black Lord's Altar.

src.title: History of the Cult of the Dragon

events.text: In the Year of Three Signs, 1010 DR, the harbor was fortified and the city walls were again expanded and rebuilt.
Circa 1017 DR, exodus of several grand mercenary companies from the Vilhon Reach elected to leave Chondath, being fed up by conflicts, wars, and bloodshed.
In 1018 DR, Tchazzar disappeared while fighting sahuagin and the people of Chessenta believed he had ascended to godhood.
During the Rage of Dragons the country suffered many attacks including Arabel, Dhedluk and Eveningstar.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 115

events.text: The Purple Dragon, Thauglorimorgorus, was slain by Crown Prince Azoun II.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 115

events.text: The Mourktar cell of the Cult transformed the great blue wyrm Alasklerbanbastos into a dracolich.

src.title: History of the Cult of the Dragon

events.text: During the year in which a dracorage befell Faerûn, Tuelhalva Drakewings had completed almost two decades of work amassing arcane secrets and uncovering ancient spells to finally release Gargauth from the depths beneath Peleveria. In gratitude for his release, Gargauth summoned an army of abishai and aligned them with Drakewing's pragmatic Cult forces, which included draconian creatures and dracoliches. After Tuelhalva Drakewings declared his faction's secession from the Cult, his army and their demonic allies marched on Peleveria, siezed its throne and established the archmage as the ruler of

src.title: History of the Cult of the Dragon

events.text: Shortly after Drakewing's victory, Gargauth assumed the form of an older mage and flew north to Urmlaspyr. Once here, he informed Algashon of Tuelhalva's victory, embellishing the tale with accounts of power gained by the slaying of an ancient undead dragon king. This infuriated Algashon, who rallied 20 other mages from the Cult, their followers, as well as dragons and dracoliches under their command and incited the wrath of the dracorage upon the nation.

src.title: History of the Cult of the Dragon

events.text: A horrific and destructive battle took place over Peleveran. It culminated with a clash in the skies between Tuelhalva Drakewings and Algashon Nathaire, each mounted atop a dracolich, with the latter astride Shargrailar. In the end both Tuelhalva and Algashon would perish, along with most of their respective armies. There were however, enough members of the Sembian branch of the Cult to return to their nation and resume the activities of the Cult of the Dragon. Despite being leaderless, the remaining pragmatists routed any Banite remnants of Algashon's influence and the cult entered into a per

src.title: History of the Cult of the Dragon

events.text: In the Year of the Dracorage, 1018 DR, during a Rage of Dragons the blue great wyrm Iryklathagra was driven to attack Mintar.
In the Year of the Dracorage, 1018 DR, the red dragon Tchazzar ascended to divinity after the Rage of Dragons devastated the Realms.

During the Rage of Dragons in the Year of the Dracorage, 1018 DR, Uruth Ukrypt lost much of its food supply and treasures when the realm was ravaged by the green dragon Claugiyliamatar and the black dragon Shammagar.
By the Year of the Smoldering Spells, 1020 DR, House Extaminos at last siezed control of the city after defeating a competitor noble family and the death of its heirless, Wariton Minlow.
Estagund raiders attempt to invade Dambrath from the port city of Darmesh. They are defeated near the city of Hethar
The Cult cell in Unther had been completely dissolved. Alasklerbanbastos retreated behind the Dragonback Mountain in the Riders to the Sky.

src.title: History of the Cult of the Dragon

events.text: In the Year of Lathander's Light, 1024 DR, a band of Waterdhavian adventurers called the Dawnbringer Company plundered the sacred Ukrypt.

In what has been celebrated as one of the greatest feats of commerce in the nation's history, the exalted Jeradeem Seltarir successfully negotiated the acquisition of the royal throne of Estagund in the Year of Crimson Magics, 1026 DR, for diamonds of almost 1,000,000 gp in value, though popular legend would have the price at only 24 pearls.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 115

events.text: In response to the growing threat of orcish tribes, Aencar Burlisk was appointed Warlord of Battledale.
Cathtyr's daughter Filina slays the queen and assumes reign over Dambrath
In the Year of the Immortals, 1037 DR, creatures from another plane appeared in Waterdeep after emerging from Undermountain.
The city of Arabel rebelled and seceded under Goldfeather leadership. Crown Prince Azoun II led the campaign to reconquer Arabel.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 117

events.text: Aencar assumed the title of "the Mantled King" and attempted to unify the Dalelands under a single banner.
Cathakay Shintar, daughter of Filina, bribes her mother's lover to commit regicide and becomes queen
The Mantled King died. The Dalelands were split into independent communities that maintained somewhat an alliance through the Dales Council.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 156

events.text: In 1046 DR, Galnorn would send a garrison out to the Ice Lakes to expel kobolds, but his forces would find themselves forced to retreat.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 117

events.text: King Azoun II reclaimed Arabel. House Goldfeather were exiled and their lands claimed by the crown.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 117

events.text: High King Bayle Carrathal attempted to annex Jannath's Tears, a small collection of islands. His fleet was defeated when Baldur's Gate came to the islands' defense, and Bayle was subsequently deposed as king.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 23–31
Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 34

events.text: In the Year of Tolling Terrors, 1054 DR, the Priest Regent unveiled his magnificent temple in a grand dedication ceremony attended by every dwarf in the city.
Circa 1057 DR, the great dwarfhold of Citadel Felbarr, north-east of Silverymoon, was left behind by the Stout Folk.
In 1063 DR, after a sudden change of heart, Deepking Tarngardt VII emancipated the derro of Gracklestugh, granting them full rights and privileges.
In the Year of the Stranger, 1064 DR, the Neverwintan wizard Melaeth Ashstaff slays the long-lived Grand Prince Galnorn, revealing him to have been replaced at some point by a doppelganger.
The Battle of Ingdal's Arm was a battle between Indrila's human army and the half-elves that took place in what would become Aglarond in 1065 DR.
Harpers operating in the North discovered the lair of the dracolich Alglaudyx. They destroyed the undead beast and looted his vast hoard of wealth.

src.title: History of the Cult of the Dragon

events.text: In the Year of the Defiant Salute, 1076 DR, Waterdeep was attacked by the Tethyrian Black Boar tribe of the Dessarin Valley, commanded by Nelethra the Winged Spear.
cites: City of Splendors (boxed set): Campaign Guide, с. 18
City of Splendors (boxed set): Campaign Guide, с. 29

events.text: In the Year of the Seer's Fires), 1086 DR, Thay invaded and captured the two southernmost cities of Thesk, Nethjet and Nethentir.

In the Year of Slaughter, 1090 DR, Elturel was among the many communities and realms that contributed forces to the alliance against the massive exodus of goblins and orcs that had left the drought-stricken High Moor.
Queen Cathakay fights a gold wyrm in the Hills of the Dead Kings, both are killed in in the battle and the queens niece Melanith is granted the crown of the nation

War-captain Imphras Heltharn of Lyrabar united the city-states of the Easting Coast, and led their combined forces in a great battle against the hobgoblin armies of the Giantspire Mountains. He was aided in this great endeavor by Soargar, the archmage's apprentice Sambral and the archmage of Baldur's Gate, Velgarbrin.

In the Year of the Dawndance, 1095 DR, he united the four independent city-states of Dilpur, Hlammach, Lyrabar and Sarshel, along with the Earthfast dwarves and star elves of the Gray Forest against advancing hobgoblin hordes from the Giantspire Mountains.

After two years of negotiation between the city-states of the Easting Coast, the Kingless Years came to end. Impiltur was reunited under singular rule with the coronation of Imphras the Great. This signaled the beginning of the Heltharn Dynasty.
During the following century, in the Year of the Chaste Maiden, 1102 DR, Estagund allied with neighboring Durpar and Var to defeat a hive of beholders that overtook the cities of Vaelantar and Assur.

The Battle of Many Arrows was a great siege in which a horde of orcs conquered the fortress-city of Citadel Felbarr in the 12th century DR, leading to it becoming an orcish stronghold known as the Citadel of Many Arrows.
The Tome of the Unicorn was lost. The historian Bhaernom Khreyt was transporting it to the Moonshaes when his ship sank.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 23–31

events.text: The armies of Thay march upon the city of Phent in Thesk. King Imphras led the united forces of Phent and Impiltur in victory against the Red Wizards' legions.
In 2366 (1116 DR), Emperor Shin Rokan tried to remove power from the barons and increase taxes.
The scrying stones of Myth Drannor were recovered by Princess Ilmara of Impiltur.

King Imbrar I led the Impilturan army into the Giantspires to completely root out and eradicate the hobgoblins once and for all. Unfortunately, many of the king's men were murdered and he himself was corrupted by the magic of the evil succubus Soneillon.
Following the king's death, his sister Ilmara was crowned Queen of Impiltur.
In 1141 DR, a cabal of Vaasan wizards raised the Ice Castle in the Lugsaas Mountains where they experimented with creating a new school of magic based on cold.
In the Year of the Sword's Oath, 1142 DR, the Coiled Cabal, a group of yuan-ti pureblood mages, awoke from centuries of somnolence and attempted to reconquer the Cities of the Seabreeze.
In the Year of the Sword's Oath, 1142 DR, the Coiled Cabal, a group of yuan-ti pureblood mages, attempted to reconquer the Cities of the Seabreeze.
The Rage of Wizards was a conflict between two dozen ambitious archmages of Tashluta and Lapaliiya, who fought the yuan-ti of the Coiled Cabal in 1142 DR.

During the 12th century DR, in the Year of the Sword's Oath, 1142 DR, the Rage of Wizards erupted between the yuan-ti mages of the Coiled Cabal and a score of archmages that lived throughout Tashalar and Lapaliiya.
In the aftermath, the ruling houses of Sheirtalar and Lushpool formed a union in the Year of Glad Tidings, 1147 DR.
in the Year of the Angry Sea, 1148 DR, and used the destroyed chambers as his own personal domain.
Circa 1150 DR, the Harpers uncovered a secret slave-trafficking operation passing along the coast of Turmish.
In the Year of the Scourge, 1150 DR, Waterdeep was hit by the plague that was traversing the Sword Coast at the time.
Circa 1150 DR, the Harpers hired a mercenary army of their own to invade Undraeth.
In 1154 DR, Akanax laid siege to the city of Cimbar alongside the forces of Soorenar.
Prince Palaghard of Cormyr and Queen Enchara of Esparin wed.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 123

events.text: Esparin was annexed into Cormyr.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 123

events.text: In the Year of the Long Shadows, 1164 DR, the master jewelers of Procampur crafted a new crown for the coronation of King Palaghard I of Cormyr.
Queen Ilmara wed the warrior Rilaun of Sarshel, a man who was half her age.

Imphras II was born to Queen Ilmara and Prince-consort Rilaun and immediately crowned the new king of Impiltur. Rilaun took up arms against his wife and attempted to seize the Golden Throne for himself. The pretender-king was defeated and continued to rule over the realm until her son came of age on his 16th birthday.
In 2419 (1169 DR), a potter of Chedoru named Jo He Ting created a set of eight magical bowls for the imperial court.
Dambrath naval forces raid the coastal cities of the Great Sea, attacking the nations of Estagund, Durpar and Veldorn
In the Year of the Majesty, 1177 DR, Telflamm announced its independence after Princess Delile Balindre renounced loyalty to the one-time ally nation of Impiltur.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 123

events.text: By the end of Ipana's rule, 1180 DR, noble families of Tezat, Azatl, and Zokil all sought to marry their families into the nobility of Nexal in hopes of getting close to the empire's throne.
The Harpstar Wars were a series of conflicts between the Harpers and the malaugrym in the late 12th and early 13th centuries DR.
The Rout of the Pirate King was the event that took place in the city of Westgate on the Dragon Coast in 1182 DR.

links.t: The Rout of the Pirate King

src.title: The Rout of the Pirate King

events.text: The Battle of Marak's Stile was a battle for control of Harrowdale that took place around 1180 - 1185 DR (no source has a precise date).
When Prince Imphras II turned 16 years old, his mother relinquished the throne and he was named the new king of the realm.
The border of Thunder Gap was officially established between Cormyr and Sembia.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 123

events.text: In 1194 DR, the crown passed to Althon's second son, Philaspur Olósynne.

While out on a hunting trip, King Imphras II saw a shrike attack and kill a small demon, believing the spectacle to be a sign from the gods. When he returned to the capital the king begun the establishment of the Most Holy Order of the Sacred Shrike, an order of knighthood that would re-establish the lost traditions of the fallen Order of the Triad.

links.t: Most Holy Order of the Sacred Shrike

events.text: In 1197 DR, Philaspur's twin daughters, Thara and Ulae Olósynne, the Gray Sisters, assumed joint power in Aglarond, as Mage-Queens.
After nearly 20 years of rule, Imphras II began to show signs of madness.

Concerned about the state of the kingdom, Imphras' eldest son and heir to the throne Talryn, sought to have his father declared unfit to rule Impiltur. His younger brother Lashilmbrar schemed with some conniving and dishonorable nobles to force Talryn into exile. Talryn managed to hide himself among the pirates of the Sea of Fallen Stars.

The Battle of the Fallen was a massive nautical skirmish between the pirate ships under the leadership of Urdogen the Red, and the allied fleets of the coastal nations of Cormyr, Impiltur, Sembia and the Vilhon Reach.
Dhalmass Obarskyr was crowned a year after his father's death.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 125

events.text: Lashilmbrar falsified news about the death of Imphras to bring his brother out from hiding. Talryn returned to Impiltur but was executed for treason against the crown.
The Dambrath navy lose several battles in a row; Queen Melanith pulls recalls the ships and begins national isolationism
Melanith dies of old age, her daughter Ausitil becomes the first queen of Dambrath to ascend from peaceful circumstances
The last Goldfeather was executed for treason.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 125

events.text: In the summer of 1217 DR, a "white war" was playing out between the armies of Colletro and neighboring Sumbria.

During he Festival of the Blades that followed the "white war" of 1217 DR, Svarézi and Ilégo attempted to steal the Sun Gem from the Cappa Mannicci, the Prince-Elect of Sumbira for the use with a new invention - the light lathe, the could melt through castle walls with the right diamond lens use.
The Glorious Revolution occurred in the Year of the Falling Moon, 1217 DR.
In the fall of Year of the Falling Moon, 1217 DR, the bloodless civilized traditions of the Blade Kingdoms were shattered by an ambitious and cruel Blade Captain of Lomatra, Ugo Svarézi.
The Turmish War of 1220 was the armed conflict of 1220 DR between the human nation of Turmish and dwarven kingdom of Ironfang Deep of the Mountains of the Alaoreum.
The Cult struck back at the Harpers during the end of the Harpstar Wars, while the latter group was under the leadership of the Harper King Thavverdasz.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 125

src.title: History of the Cult of the Dragon

events.text: In the final battle the commander of the Harpers was killed by the Red Wizard Szass Tam, who in turn was defeated by Elminster. When all was said and done the battle was a great loss for the Cult.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 125

src.title: History of the Cult of the Dragon

events.text: Circa the Year of the Horn, 1222 DR, Alion Narithryn, a noble "dragon slayer" from Westgate, traveled to Reth on orders from the clergy of Lathander.
Following the actual death of Imphras II, Lashilmbrar was crowned as the rightful king of Impiltur.

The Elversult cell courts the psionic black dragon Hethcypressarvil, and convinces him to become a dracolich a few decades later. Using his unique gifts, Cypress would eventually kill the leaders of that cell some years later.

src.title: History of the Cult of the Dragon

events.text: By 1226 DR over a dozen families had joined the DeVillar and Moorland clans in the community, and the inn called Luker's Ravensgate was built as the fledgling town's centerpiece.
cites: The City of Ravens Bluff, с. 3

events.text: The port city of Marsember was seized by King Dhalmass. Both Dhalmass and his queen Jhalass Huntsilver died suspiciously on their return to Suzail, likely killed by the Fire Knives.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 125

events.text: The islands of the Korinn Archipelago were brought under the control of the Northlander chieftain Viledel.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 23–31

events.text: Manshoon was born to the mighty warrior Harlshoon, commander of the Zhentilar and First Lord of Zhentil Keep. He had a brother, Asmuth.
cites: Ruins of Zhentil Keep: Campaign Book, с. 13
Ruins of Zhentil Keep: Campaign Book, с. 28

events.text: The first inter-dale war took place when the forces of Archendale marched on Sessrendale. The Arkhenfolk accused Sessrendale's ruler, the Dusk Lord, of polluting the dale with necromancy, harboring malevolent raiders and commanding monsters to raid caravans and murder innocent Dalesfolk. The war lasted for three weeks, after which the Dusk Lord was defeated and the land was salted so that nothing else would grow from its soil. The widows and orphans of the dale would settle in Cormyr.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 125

events.text: The Sessrendale War was a conflict fought between Archendale and Sessrendale of the Dalelands in the Year of the Weeping Wives, 1232 DR.
In 1233 DR, a number of drow from House Mylyl left the city for the Far Forest to continue their magical experiments and ended up creating the chitine race.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 153

events.text: Shaloss Ethenfrost: The only High Mage to steal the title, after wresting control of Silverymoon from another tyrannical Warlord, he ruled over the city, as it was besieged by orcs, for only two months.
cites: The North: Guide to the Savage Frontier: Cities & Civilization, с. 47,50

events.text: In the aftermath of Sepur's vanishing, an elected mayor ruled for the next three years; this reign, in the Year of the Black Horde, 1235 DR, marked the first time that an enemy broke through the city walls since the office of High Mage was established.

In the Year of the Grotto, 1237 DR, Queen Thara Olósynne of Aglarond was wed to Elthar Mindosel of Milvarune, forging an alliance between Thesk and Aglarond that lasted well into and likely past the late 14th century DR.
cites: Dreams of the Red Wizards, с. 4
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 126

events.text: In the Year of Pain, 1245 DR, Ri'ola'con became the 22nd eadar at age 116.
In 1246 DR, the Lantanna first tested bombards, as part of early developments with gunpowder.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 126

events.text: In the Year of Burning Steel, 1246 DR, the orc warlord Fottergrim and the magelord Archlis led a mixed horde of them in an invasion and takeover of Tsurlagol.
In the Year of Burning Steel, 1246 DR, the orc warlord Fottergrim and the magelord Archlis led a mixed horde of them in an invasion and take-over of Tsurlagol.
In the summer of the Year of Burning Steel, 1246 DR, the orc warlord Fottergrim and the magelord Archlis led a mixed horde of them against Tsurlagol.
The Night of Redemption was the explosive conclusion of the Reign of the Wyrm and a revolutionary conflict in the summer of 1247 DR.
Bread Riots was a violent disorder that took place in the city of Baldur's Gate in the Year of the Bold Knight, 1249 DR.
